name: ai-dancing
description: AI Dancing - AI Video Generation App

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 --log-level error --no-access-log
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.clean: cd frontend && npm run clean && cd ../backend && find . -type d -name '__pycache__' -exec rm -r {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name '*.pyc' -delete 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .pytest_cache 2>/dev/null
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules && cd ..
